message:
Dearest,

I wanted to take a moment to write this down because sometimes words spoken out loud just float away, but I want these to stay with you.

Thank you for being such a wonderful part of my life. Your smile is my favorite thing to see, and your laugh is my favorite sound.

I hope this little blue bouquet brightens your day just as much as you brighten mine.

You are truly special to me.

Always,
Your Secret Admirer 💙
